'''Assistant Historian''' was a rank within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]], of the [[Historian Corp]], held the rank of Assistant Historian.
